import re
import sys

text = re.sub(r"//[^\n]*", "", sys.stdin.read())
values = {}

for match in re.finditer(r"\b(TMP|a|b|c|d)\s*<-\s*([^;]+);", text):
    variable, expression = match.groups()
    expression = expression.strip()

    literal = re.fullmatch(r"\d+", expression)
    if literal:
        values[variable] = int(expression)
        continue

    update = re.fullmatch(
        r"\(\s*(TMP|a|b|c|d)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100",
        expression,
    )
    if update:
        source, increment = update.groups()
        values[variable] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % 100

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; c ?= {values['c']}; "
    f"d ?= {values['d']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
